title: Owner reorders work orders within a technician column on Board View and the order persists
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport at least 1280 px wide.
Saved Work Orders view reset over the API (display List, no layout keys). Technician A pinned.
Two work orders X and Y for a unique customer, both with lead A.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders, pick Board View, and search for the unique customer.
custom_steps_separated.expected: A's column shows both cards; note their order.

custom_steps_separated.content: Drag the second card above the first and release.
custom_steps_separated.expected: A drop indicator shows above the first card; then the order is swapped, no toast shows and A's count is unchanged.
